text:
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades, Downgrades & Initiations 
$GOOGL, $AMZN, $ANTM, $AAPL 
Daily HeffX-LTN reviews Wall Street analysts research reports to find new investing and trading ideas for our readers. Some reports cover stocks to buy , and others cover stocks to sell or avoid. 
Below is a list of Wall Street’s Top analysts outlook for Key issues for Tuesday, as follows: 
Alphabet Inc. (NASDAQ: GOOGL) has hit new highs and seen many target price hikes from analysts. SunTrust Robinson Humphrey raised its target to 1,250 from 1,180, and Morgan Stanley raised its target to 1,210 from 1,150. Alphabet has a consensus analyst target price at 1,189.17. 
Amazon.com Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) has marked multiple new highs in Y 2018, now SunTrust Robinson Humphrey reiterate its Buy rating and raise its price target to 1,400 from 1,270. Amazon shares finished at 1,305.20 Friday. 
Anthem Inc. (NYSE:ANTM) was raised to Buy from Hold with a 283 price target at Jefferies. Anthem shares have a 52-wk trading range of 144.44 to 237.00, and the consensus analyst target price is at 248.53 for now. 
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) was reiterated as Buy and the price target was raised to 204 from 193 at Maxim Group. The stock closed at 177.09 Friday. Apple has a 52-wk trading range of 118.22 to 177.36, and has a consensus target price at 186.32. 
Come back daily for our Key reports. 
Have a terrific week. 
Wall Street’s Top Analysts Upgrades, Downgrades & Initiations added by Paul Ebeling on January 16, 2018
